dedupe_keys.name: operation time of primary relays in ieee 30 bus network

description: Operation time of primary relays in IEEE 30 bus network is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors AFSHIN MAHBOUBKHAH. This is an excel file to compute Operation Time (OT) of primary relays in IEEE 30 bus network with 2 DGs. This file is provided to make a fair comparison between methods. It is supposed that the relays have standard inverse characteristic curve. Link to the reference where the fault currents were taken is provided. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
